title: chmod -R 777 recovery: restoring a legacy site's permissions
lede: A panicked chmod -R 777 felt like the fastest fix at 23:41. Twelve minutes later PHP-FPM was rejecting every script and the login screen returned 500s.
hero_alt: Overhead still life on bone linen: Unix permissions cheat-sheet, PHP-FPM error log, manila wp-content folder, brass CHMOD plate, red wax seal.
